entities.name: Antônio Meneses
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Antônio Jeronimo de Meneses Neto was a Brazilian cellist and an academic teacher based in Switzerland. Known professionally as Antônio Meneses, he won the first prize and gold medal at the 1982 International Tchaikovsky Competition in Moscow. He was the cellist of the Beaux Arts Trio from 1998 to 2008.
